title: Cryptographic Merkle Tree & Blockchain Audit Pipeline
prompt: Execute an end-to-end cryptographic Merkle tree computation and blockchain audit pipeline: 1. Use python_repl to construct a binary Merkle tree from 16 deterministic transaction payloads for block #1042 (transactions: 'TX_01' through 'TX_16' with deterministic values starting at 1.50 ETH incrementing by 0.75 ETH). 2. Compute the SHA-256 leaf hashes, intermediate layer hashes, and the final 64-character hexadecimal Merkle Root. Generate cryptographic Merkle inclusion proofs for 'TX_03' and 'TX_14'. 3. Save the complete hierarchical tree structure, transaction records, and inclusion proofs into 'merkle_block_1042.json'. 4. Compute audit metrics (Tree Depth, Total Tree Nodes, Merkle Root Hash, Proof Validation Status, and Total Transacted ETH) and write a formatted cryptographic audit report into 'merkle_audit_report.md'. 5. Read back both 'merkle_block_1042.json' and 'merkle_audit_report.md' to verify file integrity and assert that exactly 16 transaction leaves exist and both inclusion proofs validate to True.
